summary: Trekor Metals filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 8, 2026 press release reporting third-quarter operating results. Consolidated copper production totaled 41 million pounds: 34 million pounds from the 100%-owned Gibraltar mine plus 380 thousand pounds of molybdenum, and seven million pounds of copper cathode from the Florence Copper ramp-up, up 36% sequentially. Management guided 2026 Florence output to 25-28 million pounds, citing wellfield expansion roughly three months behind plan, with full capacity expected in early 2027. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch production ramp and grade/recovery trends.
